svg.title: Share on open devices or desktops, by four measures
svg.desc: Four panels, one per measure, each the share of activity on open devices or desktops by month: Cloudflare by operating system, Cloudflare by device type, StatCounter page views from a desktop, Wikimedia page views through the desktop site.
svg.text: Share on open devices or desktops, by four measures
